mmff94_term_audit_summary.note: 'routing_bug_candidate' = this exact atom-type tuple HAS a table row, just at a different classification/angle-type code than the one this molecule's context computed -- a candidate for a classification-derivation bug (angle_type_for/torsion_type_for/bond_type_for), not necessarily a genuine table gap. 'table_gap' = absent at EVERY classification code -- a genuine chematic-ff table gap; could in principle be closed by equivalence-class substitution, an empirical-rule estimate, or a literal missing table row, but chematic-ff implements NEITHER equivalence-class fallback NOR empirical-rule estimation at all (verified: Mmff94NumericTypeInfo.equivalence_levels is parsed but has zero readers anywhere in the codebase) -- distinguishing those 3 sub-cases requires building at least a diagnostic-only resolver for each, which is NOT done in this PR (scoped out, see PR body) -- so 'table_gap' is reported as one bucket, not the full 4-way exact-missing/equivalence-not-implemented/empirical-not-implemented/genuinely-unsupported split originally proposed.
